asked.item: Bluesky video fails with an extension-less signed URL
How to get the video published on Bluesky

verdict.reason: S106 states Bluesky needs the public media URL to end in .mp4, .webm, or .mov, and S2, S4 and S5 give the upload route to get a URL.

steps.text: For Bluesky, the public media URL must end in .mp4, .webm, or .mov so Blotato recognizes it as a video.
A URL with no file extension at the end doesn't meet that Bluesky requirement, so use a URL that ends in one of those extensions.
Or upload the file to Blotato: call blotatocreatepresigneduploadurl with a filename that includes its extension, and send an HTTP PUT of the raw file bytes to the returned presignedUrl.
After the upload succeeds, pass the returned publicUrl in the publish request's mediaUrls array.
